listingTitle: Compile constant JavaScript regexes outside loops
title: Compile constant JavaScript regexes outside loops
why: Constructing RegExp from a constant string in every iteration repeats parsing and allocation that can be shared.
suggestion: Create the RegExp once before the loop or use a regular-expression literal when its state is managed safely.
limitations: Only new RegExp calls with a single- or double-quoted literal inside a braced loop are reported.
Dynamic patterns, aliases, wrapper constructors, and regular-expression literals are not reported.
